# goton

> Non-custodial launchpad for fixed-supply tokens on Robinhood Chain (chain id 4663) and Arc (chain id 5042). Tokens launch on a bonding curve that graduates into a locked Uniswap v4 pool (Robinhood Chain) or straight into a locked Uniswap v4 pool (Arc).

goton lets anyone launch a 1,000,000,000-supply token with no mint function and liquidity locked for good, trade it, place limit, take-profit and stop-loss orders, post calls on tokens they hold, and follow other callers. Creators keep 70% (Robinhood Chain) or 80% (Arc) of each token's fees and tax, and can split it with holders, a buyback or a team.

## App

- [Explore](%APP_URL%/launchpad): every token with market cap, volume and price since launch
- [Memestock](%APP_URL%/memestock): launches with a written thesis whose creator still holds a bought position
- [Feed](%APP_URL%/feed): holder calls, Alpha Radar and Top Movers
- [Create](%APP_URL%/launchpad/create): launch a token
- Token pages: %APP_URL%/token/{address}

## For developers and agents

- [Public API](%DOCS_URL%/integration/api): read-only JSON at %APP_URL%/api (tokens, candles, trades, holders, orders, Memestock)
- [For AI agents](%DOCS_URL%/integration/agents): how an agent reads goton data and trades with its own wallet, plus a downloadable skill
- [Contracts](%DOCS_URL%/integration/contracts): verified addresses on both chains
- [Docs](%DOCS_URL%): full documentation
